# LibVLC / LibVLCSharp

This application dynamically links the unmodified official VideoLAN packages:

- LibVLCSharp and LibVLCSharp.Avalonia 3.10.2
- VideoLAN.LibVLC.Windows 3.0.24
- VideoLAN.LibVLC.Mac 3.1.3.2 (package version)

Copyright VideoLAN and contributors. The package metadata declares LGPL-2.1-or-later. The upstream LGPL text is included in COPYING.LIB.

Upstream source and build repositories:

- https://code.videolan.org/videolan/LibVLCSharp (3.10.2)
- https://code.videolan.org/videolan/libvlc-nuget
- https://code.videolan.org/videolan/vlc (3.0 release branch)
- https://download.videolan.org/pub/videolan/vlc/3.0.24/vlc-3.0.24.tar.xz

Keep the native runtime/plugin directories intact and these notices with distribution. Native libraries remain replaceable; LGPL rights to modification and reverse engineering for debugging such modifications are not restricted by this application. Native plugin dependencies have their own upstream notices/source in VLC's contrib build recipes. Review the exact binary distribution and corresponding sources/notices before external release; this preview repository does not contain a complete third-party source bundle.
